description.mn: Afnan Mirsaal of Trust: Эрэгтэйчүүдэд зориулсан хув үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: ветивер, амброксан, бөөрөлзгөнө, гүргэм; зүрхний ноот: бөөрөлзгөнө, гүргэм.
description.en: Afnan's Mirsaal of Trust is a warm and spicy fragrance specifically created for men and released in 2020. Its top notes are composed of Vetiver and Ambroxan, while the middle notes blend Raspberry and Saffron. Finally, a luxurious blend of Cashmere Wood, Carnation and Amber form the base of this scent.
